# Vendored: logseq-plugin-config

A copy of the owner's shared config helpers (names, fenced JSON, envelope, hidden state page; docs/plugin-config.md), taken from
the private repo `hdansou/logseq-plugin-config` (https://github.com/hdansou/logseq-plugin-config) at commit `598b3dd` (files `src/*.ts` and their tests, unchanged). Vendored so Planner builds and
passes CI without a sibling checkout or a network dependency (N60).

Change the helpers in the shared repo first, then copy the files here and update the commit above. Do not edit them here.
